route.title: Route
route.endsRoute: {name} ends the route. Remove it to add a stop before it.

issues.supplierNotFirst: The route has to start at the supplier.
issues.noFinalDestination: Add the final destination to save the route.
issues.stopAfterFinalDestination: Nothing can follow the final destination. Remove the stops after it.
issues.aglNotIntoAmazon: AGL delivers only into an Amazon network. Choose Amazon FBA US or AWD US after it.
issues.legMissing: Choose who ships each leg to save the route.
issues.legNotAllowed: Only the sender can ship into an Amazon network.

legs.label: Shipping, {from} to {to}
legs.arrangesNote: {company} books the carrier and adds the tracking code and cost.
legs.aglCollects: AGL collects the cartons from {company}. {buyer} books it in Seller Central and links the shipment.
legs.aglShips: AGL ships the cartons on to {name}.

fba.name: Amazon FBA US
fba.about: Amazon stores your stock, then picks, packs and ships each order and handles returns. Use it to offer Prime shipping.

awd_us.name: Amazon AWD US
awd_us.about: Amazon’s bulk storage, which refills FBA automatically as stock sells. Use it to save up to 80% on storage fees compared with FBA’s peak season.
